# JBJ Global Real Estate

> Dubai's RERA-licensed real estate brokerage. Buy, sell, rent, and invest in luxury apartments, villas, and off-plan properties across the UAE. Founded by Jane Bou Jaoude.

## About

- Full-service brokerage covering Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah
- Specializations: luxury real estate, off-plan investment, property management, Golden Visa advisory
- Licensed by RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Agency, Dubai Land Department)
- Contact: contact@jbj.ae · +971 54 716 7107
